purpose: Teach: 村井/多田/若林/上原/河合/石橋/西口/望月

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、村井氏と共同事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: When you were younger, you founded that joint venture with Murai, didn't you.
lines.style: Gentle inquiry. Sparse, reflective tone. Each clause lands with quiet weight. Eyes steady but not pressing — inviting recollection rather than demanding it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは多田先輩のご薫陶を受けられた
lines.en: Yes. I learned so much from Tada-senpai during those years.
lines.style: Measured, respectful acknowledgment. A soft pause after 'yes'—gathering the memory. Voice carries quiet gratitude. Even pacing, grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、若林氏と海外進出を企画された
lines.en: And in those days you planned the overseas expansion with Wakabayashi, if I recall.
lines.style: Gentle nostalgia. Searching tone—testing the memory, not asserting it. Slower pace. Slight lift at the end, inviting confirmation. A faint smile beneath the words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは上原氏を広報の柱に据えられた
lines.en: That's right. I made Uehara the cornerstone of our public relations efforts.
lines.style: Calm reflection. Voice settles on the key decision—'cornerstone'—with understated conviction. Warm but formal, honoring the weight of the choice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、河合氏と経理体制を整えられた
lines.en: You and Kawai worked out the accounting structure together during that period, didn't you.
lines.style: Soft recollection. Slightly slower cadence. A note of appreciation threaded through—acknowledging partnership. Trailing warmth at the end, as if touching a half-remembered moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは石橋家との家族ぐるみの交流があった
lines.en: Yes. And there was that family connection with the Ishibashi household that lasted many years.
lines.style: Reflective pause before speaking. Voice carries the weight of lasting bonds. Steady, unhurried. A quietness that says 'some things endure.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、西口社員を初代主任にされた
lines.en: You made Nishiguchi the first department head, if memory serves.
lines.style: Gentle certainty. Quiet admiration in the phrasing. Patient pacing—allowing the name to settle. A lift of recognition, honoring the significance of that choice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは望月氏に法務全般を委ねられた
lines.en: Yes. I entrusted all legal matters to Mochizuki. He carried that responsibility well.
lines.style: Calm closure. Final affirmation—each word deliberate and complete. Voice carries quiet pride and acceptance. A note of closure without finality, honoring what was built.
